capabilities: List installed plugins in a searchable side panel
Rewrite a Markdown plugin catalog when plugins change
Generate Chinese step-by-step guides from manifest, commands and settings
Back up and delete auto-generated guides on uninstall
Rewrite guides with an OpenAI-compatible model
disambiguation: Not a catalog of notes or a digital garden; it catalogs installed community plugins and writes guides for them.
extras: Desktop only (isDesktopOnly: true); plugin detection uses fs.watch plus polling. Network requests are limited to the public plugin index, plugin READMEs on raw.githubusercontent.com, and the configured AI endpoint; no telemetry and no note content is uploaded. API key is stored locally in the plugin's data.json.
problem: Obsidian keeps no maintained overview of installed plugins or their settings, so users must open each plugin's settings page to learn what it does and how to configure it.

relations.evidence: Add Kendall051021/obsidian-plugin-catalog as a beta plugin in BRAT.
with an OpenAI-compatible API key (DeepSeek by default) guides are rewritten in natural Chinese

summary: Side panel listing installed community plugins, a self-updating Markdown catalog, and auto-generated Chinese usage guides for each plugin.
